newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Canadian Imperial Bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Canadian Imperial Bank ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it reaffirmed its ratings for Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and its subsidiaries with stable outlooks.
CBRS said in a statement its decision followed news that CIBC's brokerage unit, CIBC Wood Gundy Inc, agreed to acquire Wall Street brokerage Oppenheimer & Co for US$525 million.
CIBC's short term deposits, acceptances, letters of credit and guarantees, short term counterparty, and U.S. commercial paper were reaffirmed at A-1+.
The bank's long term deposits, letters of credit, guarantees, and long term counterparty were reaffirmed at A+ (high).

CIBC's subordinated debentures remained at A+ and its subordinated debentures/notes with a single acceleration clause at A+ (low). Subordinated capital debentures (2084) were reaffirmed at B++ (high), while the bank's subordinated capital debentures (2085) were confirmed at B++.
The bank's cumulative preferred shares remained at P-1, while its non-cumulative preferred shares were confirmed at P-2.
CIBC Mortgage Corp's short term notes remained A-1+, and its medium term notes at A+ (high).
